title: 4.1 She's upstairs
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say where people are in a house with upstairs and downstairs, and ask Where's…? (Where's the boy? He's upstairs.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.1 Rooms at Home: A1 says which room a family member is in; A1+ 4.1 says which floor of the house they are on. The new items are upstairs and downstairs after be (She's upstairs.), asked with the short form Where's…? (Where's the boy? He's upstairs.) and answered with 3.4's short answers (Is he upstairs? No, he isn't. He's downstairs.). Every photo shows the same staircase from the downstairs hallway, with the person on the upstairs landing or on the hallway floor at its foot, so where they are is plain to see. 2.8's What's your favorite …? comes back with A1's rooms (What's your favorite room? My favorite room is the living room.).
prerequisite: A1 4.1 rooms; A1+ 2.4 short forms; A1+ 2.8 What's your favorite …?; A1+ 3.4 short answers.
speaking_outcome: Stress the first part: UP-stairs, DOWN-stairs; say Where's as one syllable (wairz). Do not require native-like speed.
